description: Enforces the worktree-only workflow: DENIES an Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit while the checkout sits on the repo's DEFAULT branch (detected via origin/HEAD or init.defaultBranch, never hardcoded), telling the agent to author in a separate worktree on a feature branch instead. main is for merge/pull/read-only only (the mid-session complement to the pre-push protect-main git-hook). ON BY DEFAULT in every repo that has a rig.yaml: opt out per repo with agent_hooks.worktree_only:false or per session with env RIG_WORKTREE_ONLY=0; a directory with no rig.yaml up the tree is never blocked. The block message gives the exact `rig worktree create <feature> --from origin/<default> -C <root>` command. There is NO self-service bypass (the old RIG_ALLOW_MAIN_EDIT env is removed — an agent could set it on itself); a genuine one-off main edit requests a one-time Telegram approval via RIG_HATCH_REQUEST_WORKTREE_ONLY_WRITES="<justification>" (deny-by-default; a bare 1 is rejected), allowed only on the human's approval tap. timeout_ms 960000 covers the hatch helper's 930s worst case (tg-ctl ask's 900s cap plus a 30s margin) so an unanswered/slow approval prompt resolves to the hook's own deny BEFORE the bridge's descriptor-timeout kill would fire on_error=open and silently ALLOW the main edit after ~3s; a Claude Code settings entry launching cc_hook_bridge must also set timeout >960s. on_error=open: a git/parse failure (not a hatch timeout) fails open — workflow discipline, not a security boundary. Alex tg#5742.
